school.name: Bronx Collegiate Academy
school.overview: Driven by our core values of Believe, Collaborate, and Achieve, B.C.A. is a vibrant school community that values the identity and contributions of each of our students, parents, and staff members.  While our top  priority is to provide each student with the instructional support and attention that he/she needs to achieve academic success, our roles as educators are not just academic.  We aim to produce young people who demonstrate integrity, mutual respectfulness, resilience and an appreciation of themselves, their peers, and their community.

programs.name: Bronx Collegiate Academy (X58X)
programs.description: Develop character and community awareness through a college preparatory curriculum. Rigorous instruction including college courses to provide our culturally and academically diverse student body with a well rounded, solid education.
